Climb In
Thanks for signing up. To introduce you to Patagonia and what we stand for, we’d like to share some of our history and what we’ve been doing lately. We’ve had over fifty years to refine our response to the question, “Who are we?” At the core, our purpose says it all.
Our Purpose
Earth Is Now Our Only
Shareholder
Since 1985, we’ve pledged 1% of all sales to nonprofit environmental groups as a memberof 1% for the planet. In 2022, we went one step further and made Earth our only shareholder. Profits not reinvested back into the business are paid as dividends to a trust set up to protect the planet.
Learn More
We support grassroot
activism
For almost 40 years, Patagonia has supported grassroots groups working to find solutions to the environmental crisis. But in this time of unprecedented threats, it’s often hard to know the best way to get involved. Use Patagonia Action Works to connect with activists, local groups, and communities where you are, and find ways to take action in your area.
Act Now
Fashion Is None of Our
Business
We’ve never cared much for trends. Instead, we make gear that is multifunctional, repairable and timeless—because the longer it stays in play, the better it is for the earth. Check out our newest arrivals designed for lifetimes of doing what you love.
